sequential-thinking.description: Dynamic and reflective problem-solving through thought sequences. Use for complex multi-step reasoning tasks.

memory.description: Knowledge graph-based persistent memory system. Use to remember facts across sessions.

fetch.description: Web content fetching and conversion for efficient LLM usage.

context7.description: Up-to-date library documentation for Next.js, FastAPI, React, Python packages and more. Use resolve-library-id then get-library-docs.

n8n-mcp.description: n8n workflow automation documentation — 1239 nodes, properties, operations. Use when designing automation workflows. Add N8N_API_URL + N8N_API_KEY env vars to enable live workflow management.

edt-mcp.description: 1C:EDT MCP plugin (port 8770). Provides 34 tools for working with EDT project: get_metadata_objects, read_module_source, write_module_source, update_database, debug_launch, get_form_screenshot, validate_query and more. Requires EDT running with MCP plugin enabled.

1c-transit.description: MCP Toolkit embedded server (port 6010, default). Runs INSIDE thin client on ut_rt_copy: открыть tools/MCP_Toolkit_v1.7.0.epf → Подключение → Запустить сервер. Provides execute_query, execute_code, get_metadata and more for live database access. Format: TOON.

1c-transit-6005.description: MCP Toolkit embedded server на альтернативном порту 6005 (на случай если 6010 занят). Те же tools execute_query, execute_code, get_metadata.

bsl-context.description: 1C Platform syntax assistant (alkoleft/mcp-bsl-platform-context v0.3.2). 5 tools: search (нечёткий поиск), info (детали), getMember, getMembers, getConstructors. Использовать ПЕРЕД написанием BSL кода чтобы проверить имена методов платформы. MCP-First Rule.

metr.description: METR — MCP 1С YAxUnit Test Runner (alkoleft v0.5.2). 11 tools: run_all_tests, run_module_tests, build_project, dump_config, launch_app, list_modules, get_configuration, check_platform, check_syntax_edt, check_syntax_designer_config, check_syntax_designer_modules. CheckConfig/CheckModules дают валидацию глубже чем BSL LS — видят метаданные.

mcp-1c-readonly.description: feenlace/mcp-1c v1.6.5 — READ-ONLY MCP для live 1С базы InfoBase5. 9 tools: get_metadata_tree, get_object_structure, get_form_structure (XCF любой глубины + обработчики событий), get_configuration_info, search_code (BM25+BSL синонимы), bsl_syntax_help (180 функций), execute_query (SELECT only), validate_query, get_event_log. Безопаснее 1c-transit для боевой базы (write-операции заблокированы платформой). Установлен в InfoBase5 2026-05-17. Документация: .claude/research/ecosystem-deep-revision-2026-05-17/03-RESEARCH.md
